frequency_question: How often does the Reserve Bank of India or comparable central banks deploy an incremental cash reserve ratio (iCRR) within a defined calendar window?
membership_rule: Includes official policy announcements by the Reserve Bank of India implementing an incremental cash reserve ratio or temporary impoundment of bank balances above baseline requirements. Excludes standard repo/reverse repo rate adjustments and standard CRR hikes.
window: Any four-month calendar period between 2013 and 2026.
provenance_note: 2 cases named, 3 claimed via skeleton x multiplier (1.5x)
coverage_note: 2 named episodes; estimated roughly 3 distinct periods of major liquidity surges requiring targeted absorption in the past 15 years.
known_gaps: Excludes minor fine-tuning operations that did not use the specific 'iCRR' nomenclature.
skeleton: RBI policy intervention cycles since 2010 involving targeted liquidity management.
multiplier: 2 occurrences in major liquidity overhang episodes over 3 distinct cycles.
validity_reason: Central bank operating frameworks for liquidity management evolve slowly over decades.
